title: On the Way to Jango Fett
front_description: Inspecting the clone army his Jedi brethren supposedly ordered, Obi-Wan asks Lama Su about the human prototype they used. He is told that a man named Jango Fett served that all-important function. Obi-Wan asks to meet Jango and Lama Su wastes no time complying with the Jedi visitor's request. Soon, even as huge avian creatures transport natives of this water-world to their destinations, Lama Su and Obi-Wan arrive at the Fett residence.
back_description: Michael Murnane's concept sculpture of a Kamino native.
